Like the hue of Noor Jahan, is set in 2023. Delicate, graceful and blooming from the 10th century red rose. Dancing in all the Santal glory this blend is a form of interdependency of Rose with Sandalwood. The power play of the two, light and dark Ingridients, brought together in this unique structure is immaculate. This blend could classify as an all day, only night or an only day blend. This variety of rose brings the bloom in this fragrance balancing the act with the seductive sandalwood. The sound nature of Santal grounds this blend. The importance of Lucknavi Gulab, Ruh Gulab is considered as the worlds’ most important flower in perfumery today. Rose Santal brings forward the perfect play of light & dark, or some may say masculine and feminine  nature of ingredients to light.
